title: Book from the Sky (□ No Font Installed)
summary: Real Unicode text from rare scripts whose legibility depends on the fonts your device happens to own; where a font is missing the browser prints □ (tofu), so the same work is script to one viewer and empty boxes to another.
mechanism: Canvas glyph-support detection: each rare script's codepoint is rasterised and its bitmap compared against a guaranteed-notdef codepoint (U+10FFFF), yielding a live per-device readout of which fonts the browser owns.
references: Xu Bing, Book from the Sky (天書), 1987-1991
Walter Benjamin, The Work of Art in the Age of Mechanical Reproduction (1935)
the Unicode .notdef glyph / 'tofu' / Google Noto ('no more tofu')
